question: Who among the following has been appointed as the new Director General of the Geological Survey of India (GSI) in June 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Janardan Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Janardan Prasad** was appointed as the new Director General of the Geological Survey of India (GSI) in June 2023.
 
• He succeeded the previous Director General to lead GSI, which is a premier Indian organization for geological studies and exploration.
 
• As the head of GSI, he is responsible for providing leadership in areas such as mineral exploration, geological mapping, and geo-scientific research.
 
• The Geological Survey of India, under the Ministry of Mines, plays a critical role in supporting sustainable resource development in the country.
 
• The appointment of Janardan Prasad marks a significant step in advancing India’s geological and mineral exploration initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geological Survey of India (GSI):**

 
 
• Established in 1851, it is one of the oldest scientific institutions in India.
 
• Its primary objective is the exploration and assessment of mineral resources, and it plays a key role in geoscientific research.
 
• GSI also contributes to disaster management by providing geological expertise in areas prone to earthquakes and landslides.
 
 
 
• **Functions of GSI:**
 
 
• Conducting geological surveys and investigations across the nation.
 
• Mapping mineral resources and assessing their economic potential.
 
• Providing technical inputs for mining activities and environmental management.
 
 
 
• **India’s Mineral Resources:**
 
 
• India is rich in mineral resources such as coal, iron ore, bauxite, and mica.
 
• The country ranks among the top producers of several minerals globally.
 
• Sustainable mining practices are a key focus area for economic growth and environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Geological Studies:**
 
 
• Geology helps in understanding earth processes, natural disasters, and resource distribution.
 
• It plays a vital role in infrastructure development, water resource management, and energy exploration.
 
• Advancements in geoscience are critical for addressing environmental and climate change challenges.
